thread:
zoe.design: Pushed a revised compact channel preview in Figma — main goals: keep rows dense, make suppression discoverable, and ensure keyboard + screen reader parity. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABCD (frames: compact-row-v2)

connor.pm: Nice work. Quick question: do we surface the suppression toggle as an inline pill or a small overlay panel that appears on hover/focus? Overlay gives room for explanation but may be fragile on narrow sidebars.

zoe.design: Proposal: overlay on hover, but when space is constrained fall back to an inline pill. Keyboard users should get the overlay via Enter/Space.

devin.eng: Overlay OK, but we should avoid focus loss. Suggest the overlay be dialog-like with `role="dialog"` and a `data-open` attribute. Use roving tabindex so arrow/tab navigation stays predictable.

toni.a11y: For AT, announce open/close with a polite live region: "Channel preview opened: <name>. Suppression: on/off." Important: announce after DOM content is present to avoid empty reads.

zoe.design: I'll add that to handoff. Also flag: the small badge contrast is borderline. Current BG #F6F8FF / text #6B7280 fails AA at 11-12px.

sam.product: Hmm. We need to keep compact density. Maybe adjust color tokens instead of increasing font size. Users expect compact rows.

devin.eng: Simple token swap: BG #EEF2FF + text #374151 gives better contrast. Will add tokens `compact.badge.bg` and `compact.badge.fg`.

toni.a11y: Also adjust focus outline: 3px ring with color token `focus.high-contrast` to pass 3:1 when the badge is focused. And ensure outlines respect OS high-contrast preferences.

connor.pm: UX question: after toggling suppression from the preview, should we show a confirmation modal? Could be annoying for power users.

zoe.design: How about optimistic state change + a small undo snackbar: "Channel silenced — Undo" (5s). Fast and reversible.

devin.eng: That's straightforward. We'll do optimistic toggle, call API, and revert on error. Also emit analytics: preview_toggle, undo_click.

toni.a11y: Snackbars need `role="status"` and the Undo action must be keyboard reachable and announced. For screen reader testing, add a dedicated test case.

zoe.design: Implementation detail for announcer: recommend mounting overlay then updating a visually-hidden region after 50ms to announce. Example:

```
// overlay mounted
requestAnimationFrame(() => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    liveRegion.textContent = `Preview opened for ${channelName}. Suppression ${state}`;
  }, 60);
});
```

connor.pm: Good pattern. Add it to the dev checklist. Also, add `data-testid` attributes for the preview open button and suppression toggle so QA can target them.

devin.eng: One more: if the overlay would be clipped by container scroll, we should flip to render inside a portal layer anchored to the root. That avoids clipping and keeps z-index predictable.

toni.a11y: Portal is fine, but ensure keyboard focus still lands predictably and that tab order wraps back to the row when closed.

zoe.design: I'll update Figma: add token swaps, overlay frames, tooltip microcopy, and a handoff page listing the aria patterns, snackbar behavior, and the two wording variants for product research: "Quiet window" and "Snooze".

sam.product: I'll coordinate a 3-task usability run to decide wording. Also include a short survey about discoverability of the suppression control.

a11y-bot: FYI: please include `data-testid` attributes on key controls for accessibility smoke tests.

zoe.design: Thanks everyone — I'll ship the updated frames and a short dev checklist by EOD with notes for tokens, aria-live timing, portal rendering, and undo snackbar. :sparkles:
